items.intro_words: Okay, let's get started. Once again, for those of you that are just joining us, welcome.
Roll call, please. Trustee McAvoy. Present.
Welcome, everybody. It's great to see you in person, although we're six feet apart, being cautious and keeping up with our safety rules.
Are there any changes to the agenda this evening? I'd propose that we move the three measure U's.
All those in favor? Aye. Ali, do we have any oral communication this Evening?
We have three speakers cards, but they are for our discussion item 8.1.
Moving right along to the bond program consent items. Recommendation regarding approval of bundle program consent items.
Moving on to bond program action items. The first one is 7.1. Recommendation regarding adoption of resolution 20.
Okay, on to eight discussion items. The first one is 8.1. COVID 19. Update for January 2022.
8.2 First Reading and Discussion of Board Policy 1240 Volunteer Assistance. Thank you.
Moving on to 8.3. First reading and discussion of board policy 3555. Nutrition program compliance and Accountability.
8.4. First reading and discussion of board policy 0460 local control and accountability Plan.
Along to 8.5. First reading and discussion of board policy 5141.31. Yes.
Can I have a motion to move the consent items, which include action items 10.3, 10.4, 5, 6, and 7?
Now on to 10.1 recommendation regarding revisiting the school board's March 11, 2020 vote on interdistrict transfers.
Moving on to 10.2. Recommendation. Adoption of Resolution 22, authorizing electronic meeting of the board of trustees during state of emergency pursuant to government code section 54 95.3E.
12.1. The quarterly Williams Report. Do we have any questions or comments on that?
Correspondence. We did have a email from a parent about North Star and schools of choice.
14.1 possible other business suggested items for future agendas. None.
15.1. Changes to the board agenda schedule. None this evening.
Can we have a motion to adjourn? So moved. Second.
